title: Roos limit of a termwise epimorphic completed-module complex tower
statement: Let X be any scheme and d an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let T be an inverse sequence of cochain complexes of completed coefficient modules, with an epimorphic consecutive map in every degree. Every ordinary limit cone c of T localizes to a Roos derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit] of T localized levelwise. The corresponding product exists in the derived category, and the assertion holds for every choice of product. No boundedness or completeness hypothesis on the complexes is needed.

source.place: Cohomology on Sites, Tags 0940 and 0941: the degreewise one-minus-shift short exact sequence and its derived triangle.

proof.text: Exactness of pro-etale countable products gives CountableAB4Star for the actual completed module category, by identifying discrete limits with categorical products.

Evaluate the product complex in every degree. The pro-etale epimorphic-tower theorem makes one minus shift epimorphic. The ordinary limit cone is its kernel by the universal property of compatible families. These maps form a short exact sequence of complexes.

Exact products identify the localization of the complex product with the derived product. Transport the short-exact-sequence triangle through that isomorphism; the first two arrows agree by checking every product projection.

theorem finitePerfectAdicComplex_roos
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (T : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex (CompletedAdicModules X d) ℤ)
    (ht : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), Epi ((T.map (homOfLE n.le_succ).op).f i))
    (c : Cone T) (hc : IsLimit c) :
    HasProduct (fun n : ℕ ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (T.obj (op n))) ∧
    ∀ [HasProduct (fun n : ℕ ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (T.obj (op n)))],
      IsDerivedLimit (K := fun n : ℕ ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (T.obj (op n)))
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.map (T.map (homOfLE n.le_succ).op))
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj c.pt)
